privacy: Private interpreter, prefix, config, checkpoint, provenance and checkout paths are symbolic; every input is authenticated by SHA256

feature_cache.reproducibility: Fresh-process recomputation differs from the cached snapshot by at most 1.47e-4 (pretrained) and 4.8e-7 (random) on values whose mean absolute magnitude is 0.28 and 0.77; the pre-registered bound is 1e-3. Bitwise identity is not claimed across processes.
feature_cache.direct_forward_equivalence: head(mean(tokens)) versus the full TerrainTransfer forward gave max absolute difference 0.0 on the smoke batch

results.determinism: Two independent train runs on the same cache produced identical per-arm macro-F1 values

scope.adaptation: frozen encoder; only a linear 49-way head is trained
scope.budget: frozen in protocols/p33_frozen_probe_plan.json before any score
scope.provenance_limitation: Terrain equals the published Moonstone product bitwise (reports/p3_3_mmap_terrain_linkage.md); the upstream ingestion and interpolation provenance remain the publisher's declaration and are accepted explicitly here.

caveats: Val is used for early stopping and checkpoint selection, so the reported macro-F1 is mildly optimistic and equally so for both arms
Three seeds give a sample standard deviation, not a confidence interval
Pretraining-data overlap with the Val geography cannot be excluded; this is a frozen-feature transfer signal, not a clean generalisation claim
